title: Piwigo theme manifest
description: Declarative manifest for Piwigo 17+ themes. One file per theme at themes/<id>/theme.json. Read by ThemeRegistry at load time; validated via opis/json-schema.

$schema.description: URI pointing at this schema for IDE/editor autocomplete. Optional; not enforced.

id.description: Unique theme identifier. Must match the theme directory basename.

name.description: Human-readable theme name shown in the admin UI.

parent.description: Parent theme id for inheritance. Null (or omitted) for root themes.

loadParentCss.description: Whether the parent's CSS should be loaded before this theme's CSS. Default: false.

colorscheme.description: Which CSS variant this theme presents. Read by the standard_pages search-filter and batch-manager-filter templates to pick a colorscheme-suffixed CSS file.

useStandardPages.description: When true, auth pages (identification/register/password/profile) auto-redirect to the standard_pages theme for a cleaner UX. Currently no bundled theme opts in — the global Config flag `use_standard_pages` is the live consumer. Reserved for third-party themes that want to declare the opt-in declaratively. Default: false.

assets.description: Map of asset kind ('img', 'icon', 'mimeIcon', plus theme-specific) to directory path relative to the theme root.

localHead.description: Latte template file (relative to theme root) rendered inside <head> for this theme.

main.description: Fully-qualified class name implementing Piwigo\Theme\ThemeInterface. Optional: bundled themes are pure metadata and ship no PHP class — Template.php reads their manifest directly without going through ThemeRegistry. Third-party themes that omit `main` cannot be activate()'d by the registry.

psr-4.description: PSR-4 namespace prefix to directory map, relative to the theme root.

autoload.description: Autoload configuration for the theme's source files.
